page.overview:
Who is Bait Shop Owner?

Bait Shop Owner is an elderly man who presumably lives somewhere near Catfish Lake.

When Homer tricks Marge into going into a bait shop, he starts to speak with the owner. He brings up General Sherman. He is surprised by his vow to catch him.

Josh Weinstein posted on social media an early character design sketch and captioned it,"Moleman's long forgotten nemesis."
